title: How deep does it go?
description:
A profiler has recorded what a program did as a list of events. Each event is either `"call"` (a new frame goes on the stack) or `"return"` (the top frame comes off).

Write `maxDepth(events)`, which returns the largest number of frames that were on the stack at the same time. Before the first event the stack is empty.

```
{ "call", "call", "return", "call", "call", "return", "return", "return" }   gives 3
```

If a `"return"` arrives when the stack is already empty, the recording is broken: return `-1`.
hints: Keep a counter for the current depth. A call adds one, a return takes one away.
After every call, compare the current depth with the deepest seen so far.
Check for the broken case before taking one away: if the depth is already 0, return -1 straight away.
lessonTitle: Function Calls and the Stack: A First Look
